description: Calibration corpus of the /frontend checker (ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.2): the owner's past hackathon frontends (positives), pre-2023 human-designed controls that decide tier 1, current category exemplars that feed per-category allowlists, and synthetic positives from unguided model runs. Manifest only: nothing here was rendered, built, installed or captured.

conventions.entry: {id, set, name, made_by, label_owner, render: {type, url?, replay_url?, dir?, build_cmd?, routes}, source_root?, source_paths?, source_commit?, status, check, notes, evidence}; exemplars add category; synthetic entries add prompt, prompt_sha256, brief and, when held, hold_until.
conventions.made_by: owner | teammate | generator | sponsor-template | human-designer | model. Positives carry the authorship their dossier states: FD14-F01 for its ten sub-corpora, FD10-F29's stated (unconfirmed) assumption for the two folders only FD10 lists; where git disagrees, notes and evidence say so.
conventions.label_owner: null until labels.json is merged; then the entry verdict derived from the owner's screen labels: vibecoded | not | unsure (labelling-plan.md section 6).
conventions.status: ready: can be rendered now. needs-build: a build or generation step must run first (it was not run). unavailable: cannot be rendered now, see notes.
conventions.render: url: a live page. serve: a static folder served locally (scripts/lib/serve.mjs). build: run build_cmd in dir, then serve or start what it names. wayback: url is the memento URL; replay_url adds the if_ modifier (no toolbar) and is what a renderer loads, with requests outside web.archive.org blocked.
conventions.routes: Shape of scripts/CONTRACTS.md section 6.2 routes.json, [{path, name, first?: true, viewport?}]; the first route is the labelled one. viewport names: desktop 1440x900 dpr 1, mobile 390x844 dpr 2 (touch), as CONTRACTS.md section 6.1; projector 1600x900 dpr 1 for the Monad projector mockups (their README).
conventions.paths: Paths of the owner's repositories are absolute with forward slashes; paths inside the skill are relative to its root (~/.claude/skills/frontend). <scratch> in a build command is a folder outside any git work tree chosen by the build step, never the owner's tree.
conventions.source: source_root is what the static layer reads: a local repository (with source_paths, the UI paths FD14's and FD10's scanners used, relative to it), a zip, a GitHub tree at the pinned commit for controls (fetch UI paths only, never clone: FD14-F24), or the synthetic output folder.
conventions.check: The single network or local check behind status, with its UTC time. Bodies were never stored: only status, size, title and SHA-256.

requests.controls: 14 requests to archive.org, at most 2 per site, 5 s apart: 1 CDX lookup (HTTP 503, run stopped), then after a 60 s pause 1 replay per site, plus a second replay for primer.style and demo.ghost.io after a network error
requests.exemplars: 13 robots.txt requests, one per site, nothing else fetched
requests.github_api: repository and organisation metadata (homepage and website fields, paco README at its pin); no clone
requests.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; frontend-capture/1.0; calibration corpus check, ...): the skill's own token, no user-agent swap
